name: Dolon Pass
dist: Border of Kochkor and Naryn districts
near: On the north side — Sary-Bulak (a highway junction with cafes and shops; 48 km from the A367/A365 junction to the pass per quaeldich.de), on the south side — the villages of the Ottuk valley. The town of Naryn is about 70 km to the southeast (open.kg). The earlier value “Ken-Suu ~6.5 km” was based on a catalog point offset by ~4.8 km from the pass.
elev: 3030–3038 m: 3038.4 m (silkadv.com, open.kg, Nomad's Land, 3038 m), 3028 m (quaeldich.de), 3030 m (previous catalog/Wikipedia). The recommended label is “about 3030–3038 m”.
short: Dolon is a paved pass (≈3030–3038 m) on the Bishkek — Naryn — Torugart highway between Kochkor and Naryn, the main road entrance into the Naryn basin.
desc: Dolon is the highest section of the Bishkek — Naryn — Torugart highway (roughly km 285–294 from Bishkek), linking the Kochkor valley with the Naryn basin. The saddle is a broad plateau trampled by livestock, with gentle slopes; to the north the water drains into the Sary-Bulak River (Chu basin), to the southeast into the Kichine-Kara-Kuzhur (Naryn basin); on the southern descent is the picturesque gorge of the Ottuk River with spruce forest on the north-facing slopes. The asphalt was renewed in 2024, and trucks run along the road to China and back. Since 1946 the Dolon snow and avalanche station has operated on the pass (modernized and reopened in 2023 with the support of UNDP and Japan), monitoring 17 avalanche-prone sections of the highway. The film “I Am Tian Shan” (1972), based on the work of Chingiz Aitmatov, was shot here.
guide: Dolon is not a destination but a gateway to Naryn: stop at the top for 10–15 minutes, where the road comes out onto the broad plateau, and look at the snowy ridges of the Tian Shan in every direction. Notice the buildings of the snow and avalanche station — it has stood here since 1946, and in 1972 “I Am Tian Shan” after Aitmatov was filmed here. The most beautiful part is the southern descent through the Ottuk gorge with its spruce forests, so don't doze in the marshrutka (minibus) on this stretch. It's better to have a snack in Sary-Bulak before the climb: there are no services on the pass itself. In winter and spring, check the Ministry of Transport reports before setting out — the pass is closed during controlled avalanche releases.
see: The panorama from the saddle (≈3030–3038 m) over the snow-covered ranges of the Tian Shan; the Dolon snow and avalanche station (since 1946); the Ottuk River gorge with spruce forests on the southern descent; the Kara-Unkur gorge next to the highway (open.kg); on the northern ascent, the last 3 km with a gradient of up to 8% (quaeldich.de).
skip: You aren't going to Naryn/At-Bashy/Torugart — there's no point traveling to the pass specially for the view. You want walks and trails: Dolon has no infrastructure or marked routes, it's just a point on the highway. In winter, with avalanche danger, it's better to wait for the road to open than to stand in a queue at the barrier.
diff: Easy for a drive: a paved highway renewed in 2024; the climb from the north is 48.2 km with 1196 m of ascent, the last 3 km up to 8% (quaeldich.de). For cyclists, a long but steady climb. Difficulty rises in winter and spring (black ice, avalanches, restrictions for trucks).
when: June to September — no snow and the best visibility. The highway is open year-round, but snow can fall as early as September (snow at km 285–294 — 24.kg, 10.09.2024) and even in early June (up to 35 cm on the Balykchy — Naryn — Torugart highway — economist.kg, 05.06.2026). The claim by trvlland.com that “the pass is passable only from June to October” is wrong — it is a year-round highway.
hours: An open highway, round the clock and year-round. Temporary closures during snowfall and controlled avalanche releases (for example 20.02.2023 — the road closed until 16:00, 24.kg) and restrictions for heavy trucks in winter (akchabar.kg). The current situation is published by the Ministry of Transport of the Kyrgyz Republic.
daytime: In the daytime, in the first half of the day — cleaner air and less cloud over the ranges; in winter drive through only in daylight and no later than midday, when avalanche activity and black ice increase (editorial).
how: Along the Bishkek — Balykchy — Kochkor — Naryn — Torugart highway (A365): about km 285–294 from Bishkek (24.kg), about 70 km from Naryn (open.kg). You can stop on the saddle in your own/rented car or a taxi; Bishkek — Naryn marshrutkas (minibuses) go over the pass without stopping.
needcar: Yes: the pass lies on the highway far from villages, and nobody walks here (except on horse treks — Nomad's Land: the Kol-Ukok — Song-Kol horse route crosses the pass).
self: Yes. No permits are needed and no fee is charged; your own car or a seat on a Bishkek — Naryn marshrutka is enough.
roadtype: Paved road (A365 highway, renewed in 2024 — quaeldich.de); a serpentine climb, gradient up to 8% on the northern slope; open.kg gives a maximum gradient of 14% on some sections.
traveltime: From Bishkek ~290 km — about 4.5–5 h by car; from Kochkor ~70 km (per quaeldich: 48 km from the A367/A365 junction) — about 1 h; from Naryn ~70 km — about 1–1.2 h (calculated from the distances of 24.kg/open.kg/quaeldich at an average speed of 60–70 km/h).
stay: There is no accommodation on the pass. The nearest bases are the guesthouses of Kochkor (CBT Kochkor, Shepherd's Life) and the town of Naryn (CBT Naryn); in Sary-Bulak there are roadside cafes. For specific prices see the Kochkor/Naryn entries; not applicable to the pass.
net: Not confirmed by operator coverage maps (unavailable). The highway is served by the snow and avalanche station with real-time data transmission (UNDP), but mobile coverage on the saddle may drop out — don't count on stable internet between Sary-Bulak and Ottuk.
entry: Free: an open public road, no fee for crossing the pass was found.
transfer: Marshrutka (minibus) Bishkek — Naryn (passing over the pass) — 600 som, Bishkek — Kochkor — 350 som (CBT Naryn, 05.2026). An individual transfer to the pass itself is not sold separately; agree the taxi price from Naryn/Kochkor on the spot (not confirmed).
bring: A warm jacket even in summer (≈3030 m, wind, snow possible in June and September), sunglasses and sunscreen; water and a snack from Sary-Bulak or Naryn. In winter — winter tires/chains, a full tank, a supply of warm clothes in case the pass is closed.
warn: In winter and spring the pass is temporarily closed for controlled avalanche releases (24.kg, 20.02.2023) and restrictions for heavy trucks are introduced; snow is possible from September to June (24.kg 10.09.2024; economist.kg 05.06.2026). At an elevation of ≈3030 m, mild altitude sickness is possible after a fast ascent from Bishkek. The highway is busy with trucks to/from China — don't stop on bends or in narrow spots.
food: There are no establishments on the pass itself. In Sary-Bulak at the foot there are roadside cafes and shops (quaeldich.de): the typical highway menu is lagman, shorpo, manty, beshbarmak (editorial). Specific places with ratings are not confirmed.
reviews: Google Maps: 4.9/5, 21 ratings (as of 03.10.2026, from the catalog check). On TripAdvisor there is a “Dolon Pass” listing (Kochkor, Naryn Province) — the number of reviews has not been checked. Typical pros: open space and mountain panoramas, good asphalt; cons: cold and wind, snow outside summer, trucks.
p.sum: Dolon (≈3030 m) is a paved pass on the Bishkek — Naryn — Torugart highway between Sary-Bulak and Naryn: people don't come here specially but stop on the way. It's most convenient in your own/rented car or with a driver (Bishkek — Naryn transfer from $51/person); Bishkek — Naryn marshrutkas (minibuses) (600 som) go over the pass without stopping. Eat and stock up in Sary-Bulak or Naryn; in winter check the Ministry of Transport reports: closures for avalanche releases are possible. An alternative for long trips is the Asman Airlines flight Bishkek — Naryn (2100 som, ≈40 min).

p.permits: Not needed; no fee for crossing.
p.access: Suitable for everyone: a stop by the car on a level plateau. At an elevation of 3030 m a short stop is safe for children and older people. Stroller — along the roadside. With a dog — yes.
